evidence.intent_output: docs/api/auth.md:1648 (added by this fix): a FileUserStore inside ForwardingUserStore decorators, any depth, is held to the same PROD rule as a bare one -> AuthConfigException; and constructing a ForwardingUserStore subclass (the documented decorator base, Kotlin data classes included, CLAUDE.md Kotlin compatibility) must not throw. Observed: PROD builds and writes version-1 plain hashes, and a Kotlin data class decorator cannot be constructed at all (it could before this change: the constructor only stored the delegate).

title: Canonical-path lock key is not stable for a store file that does not exist yet on a case-insensitive file system: dir/users.json and dir/USERS.json get different monitors but share one temp file, so racing first creates are lost and the file is left unreadable

evidence.intent_output: AtomicFiles Javadoc ('writes to one path (by its canonical path) are serialized ... since two writers would share the temp file') and docs/api/auth.md:747 (a FileUserStore refuses a write another writer changed; the file stays readable): expected 0 lost creates and 0 unreadable files, as for the dot spelling. getCanonicalPath() folds case only once the file exists, so for a new file the two spellings lock separately while users.json.tmp and USERS.json.tmp are the same file.
